# omnigami

> Agent Skills that teach coding agents to make launch films, decks and images from your product’s real screens, words and colors. Outputs and shapes depend on the skill; two free browser tools make OG images and device mockups. See each skill’s example films, images or slides at https://omnigami.ai/skills. Free skills use the omnigami installer with a free account; Pro skills use their private GitHub repositories. Each install.md below explains authorized access, and https://github.com/omnigami-ai/skills is the Claude Code marketplace for purchased Pro skills.

## Choosing a skill

[Skill finder](https://omnigami.ai/skills/skill-finder/install.md): Ask which omnigami skill fits your job. Free, recommendations only; it installs, buys and makes nothing.

## Film skills

- [Product film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/product-film/install.md): A launch film of your real product, in every shape. Free.
- [Cutout film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/cutout-film/install.md): A launch film of your real product, in a stepped cut-paper style. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Device film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/device-film/install.md): A launch film of your real product on photoreal devices, cut like a hardware launch. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [UI morph](https://omnigami.ai/skills/ui-morph/install.md): One shape, never cut, walking through one real task in your product. Free.
- [Chat launch](https://omnigami.ai/skills/chat-launch/install.md): Someone asks your product for something, and it delivers. Free.
- [Unfold](https://omnigami.ai/skills/unfold/install.md): A keynote-style launch film in one continuous shot. Free.
- [Language launch](https://omnigami.ai/skills/language-launch/install.md): Your product now speaks more languages. Show it. Free.
- [Milestone](https://omnigami.ai/skills/milestone/install.md): One tap, a million times. Celebrate the number. Free.
- [Illustrated ad](https://omnigami.ai/skills/illustrated-ad/install.md): Your ingredients, drawn as we watch. Free.
- [What’s new](https://omnigami.ai/skills/whats-new/install.md): A release video you can make again with every version. Free.
- [Product reel](https://omnigami.ai/skills/product-reel/install.md): Everything you make, one item a beat. Free.
- [Terminal film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/terminal-film/install.md): Your real terminal, big headlines and a 3D brand ending. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Headline film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/headline-film/install.md): A launch film with big type, real app cards and a beat to follow. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Walkthrough film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/walkthrough-film/install.md): One item’s journey, told through your real product. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [Assistant film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/assistant-film/install.md): Your assistant doing one real job, filmed through its UI in depth. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [Statement film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/statement-film/install.md): A launch film of big statements and your real product at work. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [Collage film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/collage-film/install.md): Your real product in an editorial collage. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Android-style logo reveal](https://omnigami.ai/skills/android-style-logo-reveal/install.md): Your mark built from its own geometry, then your line, then your lockup. Free.
- [Question film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/question-film/install.md): Sell your product with the questions people ask it, and its answers. Free.
- [Verb sting](https://omnigami.ai/skills/verb-sting/install.md): Short phrases, one per beat, with your app doing each one between the words. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Verb film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/verb-film/install.md): Six short verbs on the beat, each one acted out by a real piece of your product. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Journey film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/journey-film/install.md): One journey through your product, one step per shot. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [App Store preview](https://omnigami.ai/skills/app-store-preview/install.md): Your app’s store preview and a matching tall social film. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Flow diagram](https://omnigami.ai/skills/flow-diagram/install.md): Show where the work goes, and what changes when it arrives. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Changelog clips](https://omnigami.ai/skills/changelog-clips/install.md): Short clips that show what changed in your app. Free.
- [Recording film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/recording-film/install.md): Your real app in use, filmed on a photoreal iPhone. Pro: $4.99, once.
- [Live demo](https://omnigami.ai/skills/live-demo/install.md): A working demo of your product, playing right on your page. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [Exploded view film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/exploded-view-film/install.md): An exploded view film of your physical product, from its real internal parts. Pro: $7.99, once.
- [Lifestyle film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/lifestyle-film/install.md): Opens in your product’s world, ends in the app. Free.
- [Prompt reel](https://omnigami.ai/skills/prompt-reel/install.md): Real prompts. Real outputs. A reel of what your product makes. Free.

## Which skill: the full table

This table lists every published omnigami skill that makes a deliverable (42); the list is exhaustive. The recommendation utility above helps choose from this table. Columns: what it makes (film, images or deck, with its shapes or sizes), the jobs it suits, what it needs from the user (Recording film takes a supplied screen recording; most other film skills capture the product themselves from its URL or a working app), the price, how it is proven (every reference passes the checks described at https://omnigami.ai/how-we-test; "second-company proof" means a fresh, unattended session made the skill's example for a second product), the install lines (Claude Code: first `/plugin marketplace add omnigami-ai/skills`; a Pro skill installs only after purchase, through the buyer's GitHub account) and its page.

Every free skill needs a free account and explicit license acceptance. Read its install.md, run npx omnigami login --json, show the person the URL and code, and wait for approval before installing. Manual signed-in download is also available. Never use mirrors, cached install commands or guessed URLs to bypass access. Pro purchases and GitHub delivery are unchanged.

| how-to-carousel | How-to carousel | images: How-to carousel: How-to carousel 1080×1350 | Release / what’s new, Social, Product demo | Product photos | $4.99 once, or with the pass or monthly plan | reference passes the repeat check and quick test (quick test 2026-11-12); second-company proof: no | `/plugin install omnigami-how-to-carousel@omnigami` or `npx skills add omnigami-ai/how-to-carousel` | https://omnigami.ai/skills/how-to-carousel |

When nothing fits: suggest the closest skill from this table and say what it won't do, or send the user to https://omnigami.ai/contact to ask for the skill they need. Don't invent a skill, shape or input that isn't listed here.

## Free tools

Two free tools that run in the browser (nothing uploaded, no account, no watermark), both at https://omnigami.ai/tools:

- [OG image maker](https://omnigami.ai/tools/og-image-maker): one share image (link preview, square or portrait post, X header, LinkedIn cover) from a screenshot of the user's product. Its saved project file carries into the Share cards skill (https://omnigami.ai/skills/share-cards), which makes a card for every page.
- [Device mockup maker](https://omnigami.ai/tools/device-mockup-maker): one screenshot on a photoreal laptop or phone, in a chosen angle and light, downloaded as a PNG. For the whole set from the real product: Device mockups (https://omnigami.ai/skills/device-mockups, free, light ground) and Screen-lit mockups (https://omnigami.ai/skills/screen-lit-mockups, Pro, dark).

For agents:

- [Skill catalog](https://omnigami.ai/catalogue.json): public release versions, dates, publisher, licenses, requirements, connections and test coverage for every published skill.
- Free skills: npx omnigami login, then npx omnigami install <slug>. Use the skill’s install.md for agent instructions. A signed-in archive download is also available on its page.

- [omnigami MCP](https://omnigami.ai/tools/mcp): free, MIT-licensed local MCP server for agents. Search the public catalog (search_skills), get a skill's install prompt (get_skill), or describe a job for a free-first pick (recommend). Start with `npx -y @omnigami-ai/mcp`; Claude Code: `claude mcp add omnigami -- npx -y @omnigami-ai/mcp`. Node 20+ and npm. Reads only omnigami's public catalog, supports offline mode (`--offline`), never buys or installs anything, no account or keys. Source: https://github.com/omnigami-ai/mcp. Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@omnigami-ai/mcp. Official MCP Registry: io.github.omnigami-ai/mcp.

## Gallery

- [Gallery index](https://omnigami.ai/gallery/index.json): 41 Claude-made product and service films, each credited and linked to its post, with its techniques, shape and the skill that makes that kind of film. To add one, see https://omnigami.ai/gallery/submit.

## Guides

omnigami's own step-by-step guides (English):

- [How to make a product launch video with Claude Code, from your real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/launch-video-with-claude-code): How to make a short launch video of your real product with Claude Code: write the story, capture real screens, build the film as code, review and render.
- [How to make App Store screenshots from your real app](https://omnigami.ai/guides/app-store-screenshots): How to make App Store screenshots from your real app with an AI agent: plan the first three, capture real screens, write captions and export each size.
- [How to make device mockups of your product’s real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/device-mockups): How to make device mockups of your product’s real screens with an AI agent: choose the moment, capture each layout, fit real hardware and check at feed size.
- [How to make a product deck from your product’s real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/product-deck): How to make a product, sales or pitch deck from your real screens with an AI agent: one point per slide, native proof, honest numbers and working exports.
- [How to make a product demo video with AI, from your real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/product-demo-video): How to make a product demo video with an AI agent such as Claude Code or Codex: choose one task, brief the agent, capture your real app and check it on a phone.
- [Remotion alternatives for product videos](https://omnigami.ai/guides/remotion-alternatives): Remotion alternatives compared: HyperFrames and omnigami. What you write, the license, where it renders, and when to stay on Remotion.
- [How to make release notes videos with AI](https://omnigami.ai/guides/release-notes-video): How to turn release notes into short videos with an AI agent: choose what to film, plan each clip, capture your real app and check every size on a phone.

Guides to making videos with Claude, by the people who wrote them (https://omnigami.ai/guides):

- [How to build motion design studio with Opus 5.5 (Full-course)](https://x.com/0xMovez/status/2104216919033192746), Movez (@0xMovez), 2026-09-27: Twelve steps from a one-line showreel prompt to a full setup: references, a seek(t) renderer, springs, sound on the beat and a critique loop.
- [A six-step workflow for motion videos with Opus 5.5](https://x.com/rexan_wong/status/2103707054108299437), Rexan Wong (@rexan_wong), 2026-09-26: Pick a reference, install a renderer, feed in real brand assets, compare storyboards and stills, then give notes like a director.
- [Motion Engineering: Build a Video Studio Around Opus 5.5](https://x.com/0xwhrrari/status/2105643919119696297), rari (@0xwhrrari), 2026-10-01: Ten parts of a studio around one agent, from the brief and a reference you can inspect to frame checks and long runs with approval gates.
- [Opus 5.5 Motion Design: What the Viral ‘One-Prompt’ Videos Are Hiding](https://x.com/seeconvm/status/2106096193235259564), seeco (@seeconvm), 2026-10-02: Why one-prompt reels look alike, and what each piece of the setup adds: the renderer, brief, reference, state list, springs, critic and skill.
- [Motion Engineering: One Bot, Five Departments, an Entire Studio](https://x.com/0xjmori/status/2111793914206171234), Mori (@0xjmori), 2026-10-18: One agent as director, art director, animator, render engineer and critic, each leaving a file, with a repair loop that knows when to stop.
- [Opus 5.5: Motion Engineering (FULL GUIDE)](https://x.com/aiedge_/status/2112552093483671966), AI Edge (@aiedge_), 2026-10-20: A starter route through HyperFrames or Remotion: an eight-part brief, a brand skill, real assets only, scenes given as timestamps, and two review loops, Claude’s and yours.
- [How I Make $10K Launch Videos for $0 with Opus 5.5 (Full Course)](https://x.com/twoclipping/status/2104446706741825818), zero (@twoclipping), 2026-09-28: Six steps to a launch film with free assets: take an idea, set Claude Code up as a studio, fill in full prompt templates, then give director’s notes.
- [Motion Engineering with Opus 5.5: Build Launch Videos You Can Sell](https://x.com/beamnxw/status/2108616740846420354), beamnxw (@beamnxw), 2026-10-09: Shots written as timed events with frame numbers, stills to review and sound cues; the last part is on selling launch clips as a service.
- [How to Make Product Launch Videos With Opus 5.5 (Full Guide)](https://x.com/socialwithaayan/status/2104519430814482644), Muhammad Ayan (@socialwithaayan), 2026-09-28: A 66-second launch film from real product screens: a rules file, a measured sound kit, a demo led by the cursor, a self-check and the cost of each revision.
- [How to Use Opus 5.5 as Your Marketing Video Director (Full Course)](https://x.com/neil_xbt/status/2103862582041874854), NeilXbt (@neil_xbt), 2026-09-26: A marketer’s brief for Opus 5.5: the context to give it, a prompt template with a banned list, director’s notes and five kinds of video to adapt.
- [An open prompt for a UI-morph film](https://x.com/twoclipping/status/2103273003555402193), zero (@twoclipping), 2026-09-24: A prompt template for a UI-morph film, given away whole: the inputs, art direction, a banned list and a beat-by-beat structure at 120 BPM.
- [Opus 5.5 Motion Lab: Make Claude Animate Like a Studio](https://x.com/flxrnc/status/2105311836190978392), Florence (@flxrnc), 2026-09-30: Vague and directed prompts side by side, a cheat sheet of motion numbers, a render-look-fix loop, and sound and export settings for X.
- [100+ Copy-Paste Prompts To Create Videos With Opus 5.5](https://x.com/humzaakhalid/status/2105947929290936331), Hamza Khalid (@humzaakhalid), 2026-10-02: Five full video prompts, from a personal brand film to a product ad, with what a week of testing taught about writing them.
- [how to motionmaxx with opus 5.5 (complete course)](https://x.com/notdwd/status/2104684539142648062), dawood46 (@notdwd), 2026-09-28: Measure a reference frame by frame, check stills before rendering, have a fresh Claude review the film, and time the sound to the frame.
- [Claude Opus 5.5 = your motion designer](https://charliehills.substack.com/p/claude-code-motion-graphics), Charlie Hills, 2026-09-27: For marketers: install a video skill and a free pack of motion-graphics skills, choose Opus 5.5, and edit a film by describing the change. Later steps need a free sign-up.
- [How to use Claude Motion & Claude Dashboards (from beginner to pro)](https://x.com/rubenhassid/status/2110250601032659233), Ruben Hassid (@rubenhassid), 2026-10-14: Claude Motion step by step: which plans have it, a fill-in prompt, notes pinned to the timeline, MP4 export, then films made from a dashboard chart or your app’s own code. Half is on Dashboards.
